build_rlu_dataset_builder: build an RLU dataset builder by subclassing RLUBuilder and implementing get_file_prefix, num_shards, and get_features_dict
create_filename_shard: create a shard filename string from prefix, total shard count, and individual shard id
get_files_list: get a list of TFRecord shard file paths from a prefix and number of shards
create_float_tensor_feature: create a float32 tensor feature with ZLIB encoding for a given shape size
generate_examples_from_tfrecord: generate dataset examples from GZIP-compressed TFRecord files using Apache Beam
